title: What the Worker reads from its environment

entities.title: GitHub OAuth App client ID
entities.summary: Identifies the OAuth App to GitHub; one of the three settings sign-in needs.
entities.details: Set as a Worker secret (README.md, "Setting it up once (the owner)"), though it is not secret: it is in the address the reader is sent to at GitHub.

entities.title: GitHub OAuth App client secret
entities.summary: Proves the Worker is the OAuth App when it exchanges a code; one of the three settings sign-in needs.
entities.details: A Worker secret, set with wrangler secret put. Sent only to GitHub's token endpoint.

entities.title: Session secret
entities.summary: The secret the cookies' AES-GCM key is derived from; one of the three settings sign-in needs.
entities.details: Any long random string. Every pending sign-in and every session is sealed with a key derived from it, so changing it signs everyone out.

entities.title: Public origin
entities.summary: The app's address: the start of the OAuth callback address, and the Origin sign-out must come from.
entities.details: Set in wrangler.jsonc under vars. The OAuth App's registered callback must be this origin followed by /auth/github/callback.
